description: Selected sources and required runtime inputs; manifest excludes its own hash.

hardware: Vivado 2025.2, target xc7z020clg400-2; artifacts retain the paired board-validated bit/hwh.
Only used IP repositories axi_dynclk, cmos_capture_data, rgb2lcd and LCD interface definitions are included; unrelated HLS/audio/HDMI IP are excluded.
XCI files are pinned IP configuration inputs; generated RTL, runs, caches, reports, logs, journals and backups are excluded.
The generated fix3 wrapper is copied into srcs/sources_1/hdl; the published XPR references that source and has no original drive path.
sources/touch_reference is retained as design reference; active touch hardware uses AXI IIC/GPIO instead of directly instantiating these modules.
Model files and tcu_pynq runtime are selected by the software package task.
BD and all XCI files are preserved byte-for-byte; their inherited fix3 generation paths are relative output directories, not dependencies to upload.
software: Current board version: mix-plus-ab-r17-20261101-r21-keyboard-calc10; PEFSL_C124 is an optional independent PC reference.
49 digit_support/debug_binary PNGs and 20 operator_support/debug_binary PNGs are required support inputs, not generated diagnostics.
digit_support_r17.npz is present and loadable (10 classes/49 images/80D); cache-recorded bitstream and tmodel hashes match existing artifacts.
operator_support_r17.npz is absent and must be built on the board using digit_recognizer.py build --class-set operators.
TCU model data requires all three same-prefix .tmodel/.tprog/.tdata files plus current bit/hwh and complete selected tcu_pynq runtime modules.
Board prerequisites: matching Alientek ZYNQ-7020 PYNQ 2.7 image, OV5640, LCD 800x480 ID 0x7084, PYNQ/Numpy/OpenCV/cffi; no general pip install from the PC requirements on ARM.
usb_host_fix is required only when the matching original vendor image lacks USB Host; apply script enforces exact boot-image SHA256 and makes a backup. Different images must not use this candidate.
Excluded pycache, personal learned NPZ, diagnostics, historical reference test test_ab_r17_restore.py, old camera overlays/notebooks, unrelated plan histories and recovery images.
The additional Apache-2.0 LICENSE in overrides/tcu_deploy/tcu_pynq/LICENSE was copied verbatim from the existing upstream Tensil checkout under PEFSL/driver_audit/tensil_d3baeb6/LICENSE.
Software deployment and validation instructions are in overrides/docs/software_reproduction.md.
skill: Keep all 16 files in skill/: both skills and their referenced resources are self-contained. No logs, bytecode, runtime snapshots, credentials or board access passwords were found.
All five relative Markdown links from pynq-engineering/SKILL.md resolve; case_study.md/result_template.md and evidence references in pc-engineering also exist.

The pc-engineering/evidence CSV is a 22-row historical offline evaluation summary, not raw runtime output. Its recorded SHA-256 matches the local CSV. The original images, videos, NPZ archives and source run logs are explicitly not part of the skill package.
The PYNQ collector parses as Python 3.8 syntax and uses the standard library only. No hardware diagnostic collection was executed for this packaging review.

Include the four stable conclusion Markdown documents and eight SVG/Mermaid diagram files. Overrides replace workstation-specific Markdown links with checkout-relative links, fix model.md's old conclusion.md location, and embed SVG instead of redundant PNG copies.
Most plan documents describe older intermediate versions or deployment stages; exclude them from the minimal reproduction package and use the new root README as the entry point.
Original project files remain untouched. Historical links to external baseline checkouts and unselected old reports are rendered as explanatory plain text in the packaging overrides.
